title: Latest News | Saylani Welfare
text: Recent news items from Saylani Welfare's official newsroom (saylaniwelfare.com/news) include: Maulana Bashir Farooq Qadri (Saylani's patron/chairman) visiting flood victims among relief efforts in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa after severe rains and flooding left many families homeless, with Saylani volunteers distributing food, ration, medicine, and shelter to affected communities; the 'Saylani Mega IT Exam 2025' admission/entrance test event for SMIT; a visit by Javed Alam Odho, Additional Inspector General of Police Karachi, to Saylani's head office; and a visit by Saad Afridi, CEO of Scents N Stories. Saylani has also run a job fair at Qayyumabad in collaboration with KAACIB to connect skilled individuals with employers. For the most current news, see saylaniwelfare.com/news.
